notes.title: Surviving Ceres Has Just Released
notes.content:
[h2]Attention All Gamers[/h2]

My newest game has just dropped onto Steam.  It is called "Surviving Ceres".

Here are a few quick facts about the game to help you decide if it interests you.

[list]
[*] First-person survival mechanics
[*] Simulation style crafting
[*] Import/Export goods to earn funding used to advance base construction
[*] Lite automation and logistics
[*] Colony management
[*] Terraforming with large-scale systemic world changes
[*] Turret defense elements and expeditions to eradicate all hostile life
[/list]

I would genuinely love anyone interested in the game to check it out.  It has a free demo and is bundled with "Game Dev Masters" in a loyalty completion bundle with a 40% discount.

It has taken me a few years to reach this release, and I am very proud of the game.  Moving forward, I have big plans for Ceres and a new GDM update planned for the future as a [b]thank-you[/b] to players.  This update will feature many of the best suggestions and feedback gathered from players.

Thank you so much for your support, and I hope you check out my next game and have a fantastic time terraforming Ceres from a frozen ball of ice into a tropical paradise.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810070/Surviving_Ceres/

notes.title: My Newest Game "Surviving Ceres" Now Has A Store Page
notes.content:
Hey there gamers;

I am proud to announce that my next game in development now has a store page.

It's name is "Surviving Ceres" and the short description is as follows..

"Surviving Ceres is an open world survival game with an emphasis on crafting and base building. Export rare materials and manufactured goods to earn funding used to unlock new technologies and upgrades. Bring in colonists from earth to work advanced facilities to terraform the planet."

The game takes inspiration from many of my favorite games and combines them in an interesting, and fun way.  You can find out more detail on the games page or in my discord / socials.

I would love if you take a moment and head over to wish list the game to show support.  It would mean a lot to me.  Thank you and have a fantastic day.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810070/Surviving_Ceres/]Surviving Ceres Store Page[/url]

notes.title: The AI Games Has Gone Free Forever
notes.content:
It is official "The AI Games" is going free forever

This game was never meant as a major commercial product, it was my learning game.  I needed to learn about steam works and its systems.  How to use achieves, leader boards, and other steam features.  It only had a price tag so I could learn about pricing, discounts, and sales events.

I am pleased to say after 2 years of hard work, my first major scale commercial game is now releasing on June / 03 / 2022

Please consider checking out my new and amazing game called "Game Dev Masters", a modern tycoon game with a focus on player choice, depth, logic, and competitive play.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1478350/Game_Dev_Masters/

There is a free demo available.  Wish list or purchase to show your support.  Thank you

Al though this game "The AI Games" was a learning project, and never meant to make any money.  It is a fun and quirky 3-6 hour play through that jumps from genre to genre, and will most likely give you a laugh or 2.  Especially as a gamer the subtle jokes and game puns should come through.

This was my first steam game, and will always have a special place in my heart.  I am pleased to make it available for free to anyone that wishes to see where I came from, and how far I have come over the years.

Enjoy the AI games for free forever, and please support my newest game "Game Dev Masters".  The price will be set to free shortly once valve has approved this change.  Within the week it will be free.

You can also feel free to join my discord to stay up-to-date on all my work
https://discord.gg/WfbXE4cDVA

notes.title: Update 2.1
notes.content:
Just a quick fix to the previous 2.0 update.

- If you restart from checkpoint during the tutorial you are moved to level 1.

This has been changed to re-spawn you at the start of the tutorial

I also added a objective tracker that stays on screen during the tutorial, that will update each time you reach the next section.

This should handle anyone who didn't read an instruction or just forgets what to do, I got you covered now..

notes.title: Major Update 2.0
notes.content:
[h1]First major Update 2.0 is Live.[/h1]

This updates brings a variety of fixes, additions, and major reworks.  Based on feedback I have received this far from some amazing players.

- New User options including a mouse sensitivity slider 

- A Total rework to the tutorial.

The old text wall of buttons / mechanics / skills has been replaced with an interactive tutorial that engages the player, and forces them to use mechanics and skills to make there way through the tutorial.  It was to easy for Players to start the first level and not have retained everything thrown at them in the text wall tutorial, this should no longer be the case and players should now be more ready to take on World 1 after the tutorial.

Also added a skip for the opening story setup, if anyone who has played through the game wants to start a new game to see the new tutorial you can skip the opening cut scenes by pressing pause menu (default ESC key) and selecting yes to skip.

- Total Rework to the Inventory System

My inventory although functional was way to stats to your face heavy.  In total there were 70 different text stats displayed all at once.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35529613/e9af544a0b7a0dc88e89dd83ef439947bcecd8cf.png[/img]

I have remade the UI into a much more compact system that simply shows which slots are empty and which have weapons, and if that weapon is a primary or a secondary.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35529613/6da97d324b9f961179e899c6b91c299b14d84f2e.png[/img]

Upon selecting a weapon from your inventory you are presented with a comparison window which is color coded to quickly allow the player to decide if this weapon is an upgrade and should be equipped or if its not and should be scrapped for gold.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35529613/b94023bf1ef6ab3ef91c885ed7c0c397854a30e0.png[/img]

Overall this new Inventory is designed to make inventory management easy and quick and let you get back to murdering quickly without sacrificing on upgrades.

- Other menus such as the Gun Perks and Passive skills have had minor tweaks and fixing of anchor points that were out of line but have not been majorly overhauled yet.  Although they are much simpler and less of an issue than the Inventory was, but I would love to make them more graphical one day.

Few small fixes

- Some sounds were considered music and some music was considered SFX this has been fixed.
- Tweaked the impulse values in world 2 boost platform area.
- Removed destructible blocks that were covering  FPBs in level 1 that gave issues to people trying to navigate through level 1.
- Minor light tweaks on level 1 and 3 that were over exposed in some areas.
- Reduced the length of the marble maze in level 2 as it was a bit to tough for a lot of people.
- Re balanced some mobs in the earlier stages of the game, they should scale better with you as you level now.
- Added a few extra fire pits / edible bush's in world 3 to make it feel less rushed 
- Added a re-spawn point int he platforming section of world 4.  Well its not a re-spawn but if you fall in the final sections (the hardest bits) way above the level instead of falling all the way back to the beginning, you will instead teleport to the top of the elevator and can re-try the final sections. 
- Tweaked shadows and reflections on World 5 to better reflect the environment I was trying to create (another pass of this to come)
- Added an edge check on World 6 to fix a random issue that could arise depending on what choices the player makes.

There is a few small tweaks that aren't worth mentioning as it would make the thread to long such as moving several mesh's positions / changing some mob patrols and attack patterns / sound attenuation settings / and 1000's of lines of code were revisited and cleaned and rewritten to better optimize the game.

This marks a big milestone for me as a developer and it's only the beginning.  My next 3.0 update will focus on re-making the entire level 1 and portions of level 2.  This game is my first game and I grew so much over the course of making it.  Everyone who plays through my entire game says the same thing, "You can physically see you getting better as a developer as you progress through the game.  Later levels are so much better made and coded with better game mechanics".  

This is a very true statement that I agree with.  Over the course of working on this game 14 hours a day 7 days a week for a year I grew as a dev in huge ways.  Which is great, but sadly it means my first level which is arguably the most important level as its the first impression you make to players, is my weakest level and not the best representation of what I am capable of.  So my next update will aim to address this.

I of course will be on hand to fix any new issues that arise or small tweaks based on feedback while working towards a 3.0 build.  Thank you for your time and I hope you enjoy the game.

notes.title: Update 1.9
notes.content: Added new art assets to match the new library beta steam just launched.

notes.title: Update 1.8
notes.content:
Updated some graphic fixes such as the client image and library icons.  We now have a nice visible icon for every store / library option.  They are still just the black and white text version but I hope to one day upgrade to some more visually pleasant images.

Currently working on the first major update I am calling 2.0

This update will feature

-additional user options and settings
-revamped inventory UI systems
-some QOL changes 
-completely new tutorial section featuring an interactive experience that will better prepare the player for world 1
-Another pass at spelling / grammar (one day if I have the money I would love to have a professional proof reading done, instead of just using spell checks and grammar check applications that are great but not perfect.)
-few color changes for worlds and enemies in some areas where they can be hard to see from the contrast of the 2


This first major update features are all based on feedback and suggestions I have received from the twitch streamer https://www.twitch.tv/lethallimit  as well as many from the amazing redit community  https://www.reddit.com/r/RandomActsOfGaming/search?q=randomactsofgaming&restrict_sr=on

The giveaways I have run on that reddit have really helped me see the good in my game as well as the bad which I hope to turn into good.

I hope to launch 2.0 within the month.

notes.title: Update 1.7
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug that could prevent completion on world 6.

Big thank you to AZAZ3AL for finding and reporting this bug, I believe I have implemented a solution so this wont occur for anyone else.

There are many things I can not do as a small indie dev, but I can listen to feedback and reports and give them my highest priority and full dedication to ensuring the user experience is clean and smooth start to finish.

notes.title: Update 1.6
notes.content:
Just Pushed a new build live...

Based on player feedback

- Back section of world 4 is very punishing for fails..

I want to keep the difficulty because I feel its balanced and fun but I don't want to frustrate players on fails.  So the compromise I have come up with is now if you fall in the final sections past the elevator,  Instead of falling to the beginning of the level you will be ported back to the top of the elevator and only need to re-complete the final 2 challenges..

I'm thinking this checkpoint will be disabled on hard difficulty but I am open to feedback.

- Tweaked some attenuation settings and sound mix class modifiers for boss level 2, world 3 and world 6.

-Modified the amount of mobs in a few sections to reduce difficulty, please let me know how the levels flow now with this reduction.

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.content:
-Fixed a few clipping issues in world 5
-Increased the forgiveness for the jump-pads in world 2 based on feedback
-Fixed a few small bugs with Ai in world 4
-Few minor polish added in a few areas 

Work will continue on polish / steam features as well as any newly reported bugs will take priority

notes.title: We Are Live
notes.content:
The Ai Games has just launched, a huge thank you to everyone for helping me get to this point.  

To anyone who decides to support my development dreams thank you so much, and please if you have any issues report them in the steam page I will fix it asap. Please give me some feedback and suggestions as well to help push further development in the right direction.

I have implemented steam achieves to a beta build, its working but has caused some other issues.  I don't want to push it live until its in a better place but all achieves will be based off your save file so you wont need to re-do anything to receive the newly added achieves.

If you do encounter any isolated bugs please restart from checkpoint in the pause menu, this should temporarily fix most issues and I will fully remove any reported issues as soon as I see them.

Please have fun and go serve your creator well in the games..

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
After a good helping of tests, Ive implemented a number of fixes as well as changed a few things based on player feedback to create a better feeling experience overall.

Huge thank you to all my testers I'm now feeling confident the game will run well at launch for all types of players / systems.

I haven't implemented steam achieves yet but that's next on the table provided there are no issues that arise from continued testing / support.
